texts.text: ALL VALVES ARE SHOWN IN NORMAL OPERATING POSITION.
INSTRUMENT IDENTIFICATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH ISA 5.1.
SEA WATER PIPES TO BE GALVANIZED STEEL OR CU-NI 90/10.
SEA CHESTS TO BE PROVIDED WITH VENT AND STEAM / AIR BLOW-OUT CONNECTIONS.

findings.description: OVERBOARD: no non-return valve on the route from CENTRAL F.W. COOLER, TO FIRE & G/S PUMP SUCTION. Shell discharges need an automatic non-return valve with positive means of closing (an SDNR valve satisfies both); locally operated valves may be accepted in manned machinery spaces.
